1. Open aistudio.google.com/apikey and sign in with Google.
2. Choose Create API key and copy it.
3. Paste it here.
Free tier: it can be busy at times, Google may use your questions to improve its products, and it is not offered in the EEA, UK or Switzerland, where a paid key is needed.

1. Open console.groq.com/keys and sign in.
2. Choose Create API Key and copy it.
3. Paste it here.
Free tier with a daily limit.

1. Open platform.openai.com/api-keys and sign in.
2. Add some credit under Billing.
3. Choose Create new secret key, copy it and paste it here.
A ChatGPT subscription does not include API use, but Pro and Business plans can claim monthly API credits. About %1$s for a hundred questions.

1. Open platform.claude.com/settings/keys and sign in.
2. Add some credit under Billing.
3. Choose Create Key, copy it and paste it here.
Check Billing on that page, as a Claude subscription may not cover it. About %1$s for a hundred questions.
Any service with the OpenAI format works: OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Mistral, or a model on your own PC. Enter its address, its model name and your key.
